A consumer fintech (8M users): a Technology & SaaS program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Dataq Software team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Fraud rings scaled faster than rules; manual review burning margin.
Alternative credit signals unused; underwriting blunt. Regulator attention rising; evidence maturity lagging.

The streaming decision hub scores onboarding and transactions with network analytics and policy layers under replay; alternative-data features (consented) improved underwriting quality; and compliance-as-code mapped controls to licensing conditions — the audit became evidence sampling.
What the success is actually made of

items: the agents ran inside a policy envelope with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
one governed definition per metric ended the metric disputes before the build scaled.
detection was tuned to the attacks this client actually faced, not to a generic threat slideshow.
